generalized_heuristic: When extracting web news or corporate media pages, strip navigational chrome, sidebar teasers ('Most Popular', social icons), and comment sections. If a domain exhibits noisy boilerplate, switch to precision_html_extract targeting the main article and author containers.
underlying_mechanism: Standard DOM text extraction pulls in sidebar navigational clutter and user comments, polluting downstream analysis with unanchored tokens.
incident_context: Discovered navigation and comment pollution in news crawls (e.g. futurism.com, evidencenetwork.ca).

generalized_heuristic: Route document acquisition based on content payload type: use acquire_arxiv_document for arXiv URLs to retrieve official author/abstract metadata; use download_remote_pdf for direct PDF links; for paywalled academic publishers, log the status without stalling pipeline execution.
underlying_mechanism: Generic web scrapers fail on binary PDF payloads or specialized preprint APIs, producing corrupted text dumps.
incident_context: Harmonized URL routing logic across arXiv API, direct PDF files, and academic repositories.

generalized_heuristic: When an inbound target operates behind a hard commercial paywall or deterministic authentication barrier, do not waste execution turns or retry loops attempting speculative browser bypasses. Immediately record the access barrier in cargo.failed_metadata and report the failure.
underlying_mechanism: Hard commercial paywalls (e.g. Law.com, FT, WSJ) require verified user credentials; blind retries waste tokens and trigger anti-bot bans.
incident_context: Author Directive: Prohibit wasting turns on hard paywall domains per ADR-003 and ADR-010.
